description:
Residual from bedrock-5yi (coordinator election storms). The 5yi fix works around these in the coordinator's raft adapter (stale-timer flush; election timeout sized to 5 heartbeat intervals), but the library-side amplifiers remain (bedrock_raft 0.10.x, hex dep; paths relative to deps/bedrock_raft/lib/bedrock/raft):

1. mode/leader.ex ~436-443: the heartbeat tick skips any follower heard from within the last interval, so followers see AppendEntries every OTHER tick (~200ms at a 100ms tick). Measured in the 3-node harness. Halves the effective heartbeat rate the election timeout has to outlast.
2. mode/leader.ex ~140-167 + follower_tracking.ex ~40-45: on winning an election the new leader sends nothing immediately and marks every follower as just-heard, so its first heartbeat can arrive a full skipped interval later — the window where followers' timers fire and re-elect.
3. raft.ex ~195-204: no PreVote (Raft thesis §9.6) and no leader stickiness — a follower that times out (e.g. a coordinator stalled 50-200ms in DETS, or a node rejoining with a stale term) bumps the term and deposes a healthy leader. Not observed driving the measured storms, but it's the standard protection.

Expected: a new leader asserts itself immediately; every follower receives a heartbeat every tick (or the tick/timeout ratio is documented and consumers can size to it); elections require a PreVote round. Fix belongs in /Users/j5n/Workspace/bedrock_raft (separate repo), then bump the dependency.
title: bedrock_raft: new leader sends no immediate heartbeat, heartbeats skip recently-heard followers, and there is no PreVote
